errors.evidence: The chart contains only three data series, as indicated by the legend and the visible lines. The description incorrectly states there are four.

errors.text_span: Линията започва в точката (2018, 310000), намалява до (2019, 280000), продължава да намалява до (2020, 240000), след което се повишава до (2021, 260000) и завършва в (2022, 290000).
errors.evidence: The description provides a series of values for the blue line ('38.1. Събиране на отпадъци') that do not correspond to its actual path on the chart. The actual blue line starts at approximately 170,000, not 310,000, and the subsequent values are also incorrect.

errors.text_span: Тя започва в (2018, 330000), нараства до (2019, 340000), продължава да нараства до (2020, 350000), нараства до (2021, 370000) и завършва в (2022, 410000).
errors.evidence: The numerical values reported for the orange line ('38.2') are consistently inaccurate. For example, it starts at approximately 315,000 (reported as 330,000), has a value of about 380,000 in 2021 (reported as 370,000), and ends at about 420,000 (reported as 410,000).

errors.text_span: намалява до (2019, 210000), повишава се до (2020, 240000), след което намалява до (2021, 220000)
errors.evidence: The description of the trend for the gray line ('38.3') is incorrect. The chart shows the line increases from 2018 to 2019, then decreases from 2019 to 2021. The description incorrectly states it decreases from 2018 to 2019 and then increases from 2019 to 2020.

errors.text_span: Четвъртата линия е в цвят тъмносин и представлява „38.4. Други“. Тя започва в точката (2018, 160000), намалява до (2019, 150000), остава приблизително постоянна до (2020, 150000), повишава се до (2021, 180000) и завършва в (2022, 210000).
errors.evidence: The entire description of a fourth, dark blue line is fabricated. No such line or corresponding legend entry ('38.4. Други') exists in the figure.
